prohibited_non_transition.description: Raising max_slowdown_ratio from 1.35 to a number large enough to pass the measured 4.39x would be gate-weakening, not a scientific transition. That path is refused.

claim_boundary.argument: None of the permitted claims requires that concurrent cells generate tokens at the same wall-clock rate as a solitary cell. Continuity, transfer, retention, and coherence require that each paired cell complete its scheduled work before phase and microcycle deadlines with equal candidate/control resources, no leakage, and durable state. Simultaneous generation latency is an implementation congestion symptom on a shared GPU, not a treatment factor.

treatment_variable_boundary.treatment: endogenous developmental memory difference between candidate and control under equal queues, calls, tools, retries, and compute
not_treatment: per-cell slowdown relative to width-1 under shared-GPU contention
matching single-cell generation wall time at full width
treatment_variable_boundary.capacity_variable: whether every frontier cell finishes tool-bearing and model work before its phase, microcycle, event, and checkpoint deadlines at width eight

reframing_numbers.interpretation: A single shared GPU cannot make eight concurrent cells as fast as one; Odyssey does not require that. It requires every cell to finish before its deadline. Measured headroom is large under the real schedule.

what_is_gained: Capacity admission aligned to the frozen Odyssey schedule (1800 s phase, 7200 s microcycle) rather than an auxiliary simultaneity ratio.
Explicit reporting of both slowdown (historical congestion) and deadline utilization (load-bearing capacity) side by side.
Mandatory real tool-bearing work and per-frontier tool proof at full width.
Mutation surface against synthetic work, suppressed tools, cache replay, unfair queues, wrong denominators, missing cells, dropped failures, and pageout reset.
what_is_given_up: G06-DC does not claim that concurrent generation is free of slowdown; the 4.39x fact remains.
G06-DC does not establish seven-day scientific outcomes, model quality, or claim-boundary success on the permitted dimensions.
G06-DC does not replace G06's historical evidence; G06 remains sealable and _validate_g06 remains unchanged including the 1.35 limit.
G06-DC is not yet a member of the frozen G01-G15 launch_gates list in the hardened design; integrating it into launch requires a separate design freeze (see sealed_gate_set_note).

sealed_gate_set_note.problem: The frozen hardened design and operator-input path require exactly the G01-G15 launch set. Renaming G06 or expanding that set inside this transition would either rewrite frozen launch_gates or force a 16th operator-input evidence slot without a design freeze.
sealed_gate_set_note.minimum_change_chosen: Register G06-DC as a sealable side machine gate (SIDE_MACHINE_GATE_SPECS) with full validator and seal_machine_gate support, without altering GATE_SPECS G01-G15 or the frozen hardened design.
future_design_freeze_options: Replace G06's launch-gate role with G06-DC while keeping G06 historical-only, or
Add G06-DC as an additional launch gate after regenerating the frozen build and operator-input templates.

fail_closed_policy: If the tool-bearing workload misses deadlines at width 8, G06-DC must refuse. Do not tune deadline limits until a genuine measurement passes. A capacity refusal against real work is a legitimate scientific outcome.

limits_not_chosen_to_pass.derivation: Limits are frozen from the real schedule (phase 1800 s, microcycle 7200 s) with explicit headroom factors stated in the task contract. They are not back-fit from the 4.39x slowdown.
